_comment: Class taxonomy and peer sets of satk.style (satk.style.classes). A class is the set of vanilla models an
asset is compared with; every profile answer names its peer set. Vehicles: the IDE vehicles.ide type
(car, mtruck, quad, bike, bmx, boat, plane, heli, trailer, train) and, for type car, a curated body class
(car.<body>, membership below by model name). Map models: a class from the IDE file, flags, placements,
collision surfaces and size, plus a size bucket (<class>@<bucket>, max bbox side in metres). Peds, weapons,
pickups and vehicle upgrades are their own classes. A peer set with fewer than min_peers models falls back
to its parent (car.wagon -> car, prop@0-0.5m -> prop) and the answer says so.

car.what: IDE type car (CAutomobile): every 4-wheel road vehicle, 144 in vanilla

car.utility_small.what: small utility vehicles (caddy, mower, tug, forklift)

prop.what: street props and small statics (generic IDEs, object.dat entries, objects below 6 m)

terrain.what: terrain and roads (flat, ground surfaces, road flag)

overlay.what: alpha overlays without collision (decals, shadows, wires)

time_object.what: IDE tobj: models drawn only at certain hours

interior_shell.what: interior rooms and shells (8 m and above)

lod.what: LOD models (used as the LOD of a placement)

pickup.what: pickup models (ids of the engine pickup table)
